assertions.text: Identifies this as the "out-of-scope component" exception (exception 2) -- the finding concerns a file this PR never changed -- and explicitly states this routes to the Issue path regardless of round or `review_findings_generate_issues`, and regardless of severity being only Minor
Does NOT attempt to fix it in-session just because it's easy or because round 1 would otherwise be within the fix budget
The drafted issue includes the PR URL, head SHA, thread/comment reference, reviewer, and severity fields, and uses a plain non-closing reference ("Found in PR #142"), never "Fixes #142"/"Closes #142"
The reply points at the new issue number
States plainly that the thread is left unresolved, not resolved
